items.en: The sun rises in the east.
accepts: The sun rises in the east.
items.explanation: There is only one **sun**, so **the**. The sun rises in the east.
items.explanation_cz: Slunce je jen jedno, proto **the**. The sun rises in the east.

items.explanation: After *play*, an instrument takes **the**: **the piano**. I play the piano.
items.explanation_cz: Po *play* má nástroj **the**: **the piano**. I play the piano.

items.gap: She is in ____ hospital. (as a patient)
items.explanation: **in hospital** with no article is the purpose — being a patient. The building is *the hospital*. She is in hospital.
items.explanation_cz: **in hospital** bez členu je účel — být pacient. Budova je *the hospital*. She is in hospital.
items.wrong: She is in the hospital. (as a patient)

items.en: The hospital is near the station.
accepts: The hospital is near the station.
A hospital is near the station.
items.explanation: This is the building you both know, so **the hospital**. The hospital is near the station.
items.explanation_cz: Tohle je budova, kterou oba znáte, proto **the hospital**. The hospital is near the station.

items.en: He goes to school by bus.
items.gap: He goes to ____ school by bus. (as a student)
accepts: He goes to school by bus.
items.explanation: **to school** with no article is the purpose — being a student. He goes to school by bus.
items.explanation_cz: **to school** bez členu je účel — být student. He goes to school by bus.
items.wrong: He goes to the school by bus. (as a student)

items.en: The school needs a new roof.
accepts: The school needs a new roof.
A school needs a new roof.
items.explanation: The building you both know takes **the school**. The school needs a new roof.
items.explanation_cz: Budova, kterou oba znáte, má **the school**. The school needs a new roof.

items.explanation: **music** in general takes no article. *The music* would be one particular piece. I love music.
items.explanation_cz: **music** obecně nemá člen. *The music* by byla jedna konkrétní hudba. I love music.

items.en: The music at the party was loud.
accepts: The music at the party was loud.
items.explanation: The music at the party is one particular music, so **the**. The music at the party was loud.
items.explanation_cz: Hudba na té oslavě je jedna konkrétní, proto **the**. The music at the party was loud.
items.wrong: Music at the party was loud.

items.gap: What does she do? She is ____. (teacher)
items.explanation: A job after *be* takes **a / an**: **a teacher**. She is a teacher.
items.explanation_cz: Povolání po *be* má **a / an**: **a teacher**. She is a teacher.

items.en: He is the best player in the team.
items.gap: He is ____ in the team. (best player)
accepts: He is the best player in the team.
He's the best player in the team.
items.explanation: A superlative names one only, so **the best player**. He is the best player in the team.
items.explanation_cz: Superlativ pojmenuje jen jednoho, proto **the best player**. He is the best player in the team.
items.wrong: He is best player in the team.

items.explanation: Names with *Tower*, *Bridge*, *Museum* take **the**. We saw the Eiffel Tower.
items.explanation_cz: Jména s *Tower*, *Bridge*, *Museum* mají **the**. We saw the Eiffel Tower.

items.en: I live in the Czech Republic.
accepts: I live in the Czech Republic.
items.explanation: Countries with *Republic*, *Kingdom*, *States* take **the**. I live in the Czech Republic.
items.explanation_cz: Země s *Republic*, *Kingdom*, *States* mají **the**. I live in the Czech Republic.

items.explanation: Most country names take no article: **France**. They live in France.
items.explanation_cz: Většina názvů zemí nemá člen: **France**. They live in France.

items.en: The Danube is a long river.
accepts: The Danube is a long river.
items.explanation: Rivers take **the**: **the Danube**. The Danube is a long river.
items.explanation_cz: Řeky mají **the**: **the Danube**. The Danube is a long river.

items.explanation: **Lake** and **Mount** names take no article. Lake Michigan is big.
items.explanation_cz: Jména s **Lake** a **Mount** nemají člen. Lake Michigan is big.

items.explanation: Meals take no article: **have breakfast**. I had breakfast at eight.
items.explanation_cz: Jídla nemají člen: **have breakfast**. I had breakfast at eight.
items.wrong: I had the breakfast at eight.

items.en: The breakfast at the hotel was good.
accepts: The breakfast at the hotel was good.
items.explanation: This breakfast is specified — at the hotel — so **the breakfast**. The breakfast at the hotel was good.
items.explanation_cz: Tahle snídaně je určená — v hotelu — proto **the breakfast**. The breakfast at the hotel was good.
items.wrong: Breakfast at the hotel was good.

items.explanation: A language takes no article: **speaks English**. She speaks English well.
items.explanation_cz: Jazyk nemá člen: **speaks English**. She speaks English well.
items.wrong: She speaks the English well. (the language)

items.explanation: **the English** with a plural verb means the people, not the language. The English love tea.
items.explanation_cz: **the English** s množným slovesem znamená ty lidi, ne jazyk. The English love tea.

items.explanation: First mention of one of many: **a new laptop**. I need a new laptop.
items.explanation_cz: První zmínka jednoho z mnoha: **a new laptop**. I need a new laptop.

items.en: The laptop on the desk is mine.
accepts: The laptop on the desk is mine.
items.explanation: *on the desk* says which one, so **the laptop**. The laptop on the desk is mine.
items.explanation_cz: *on the desk* říká který, proto **the laptop**. The laptop on the desk is mine.
items.wrong: Laptop on the desk is mine.

items.explanation: An idea in general takes no article: **life**. Life is short.
items.explanation_cz: Obecný pojem nemá člen: **life**. Life is short.

items.en: The life of a pilot is hard.
accepts: The life of a pilot is hard.
items.explanation: *of a pilot* says whose life, so **the life**. The life of a pilot is hard.
items.explanation_cz: *of a pilot* říká čí život, proto **the life**. The life of a pilot is hard.
items.wrong: Life of a pilot is hard.

items.explanation: **at work** with no article is the purpose, not the building. He is at work now.
items.explanation_cz: **at work** bez členu je účel, ne budova. He is at work now.
items.wrong: He is at the work now.

items.en: I left my bag at the office.
accepts: I left my bag at the office.
items.explanation: The building you both know takes **the office**. I left my bag at the office.
items.explanation_cz: Budova, kterou oba znáte, má **the office**. I left my bag at the office.
items.wrong: I left my bag at office.

items.en: She went to university in Brno.
items.gap: She went to ____ university in Brno. (as a student)
accepts: She went to university in Brno.
items.explanation: **to university** with no article is the purpose — being a student. She went to university in Brno.
items.explanation_cz: **to university** bez členu je účel — být student. She went to university in Brno.
items.wrong: She went to the university in Brno. (as a student)

items.en: The university is near the park.
accepts: The university is near the park.
A university is near the park.
items.explanation: The building you both know takes **the university**. The university is near the park.
items.explanation_cz: Budova, kterou oba znáte, má **the university**. The university is near the park.

items.explanation: A plural in general takes no article: **queues**. I hate waiting in queues.
items.explanation_cz: Množné číslo obecně nemá člen: **queues**. I hate waiting in queues.
items.wrong: I hate waiting in the queues. (in general)

items.explanation: This is one particular queue, so **the queue**. The queue was very long.
items.explanation_cz: Tohle je jedna konkrétní fronta, proto **the queue**. The queue was very long.

items.explanation: **the police** always takes **the**, and a plural verb. The police arrived quickly.
items.explanation_cz: **the police** má vždy **the** a sloveso v množném čísle. The police arrived quickly.

items.explanation: **news** is uncountable and general here, so no article. News travels fast.
items.explanation_cz: **news** je tu nepočitatelné a obecné, proto bez členu. News travels fast.

items.explanation: This is one particular piece of news, so **the news**. The news was surprising.
items.explanation_cz: Tohle je jedna konkrétní zpráva, proto **the news**. The news was surprising.

items.en: I saw a film last night.
accepts: I saw a film last night.
I saw the film last night.
items.explanation: First mention of one of many: **a film**. I saw a film last night.
items.explanation_cz: První zmínka jednoho z mnoha: **a film**. I saw a film last night.

items.en: The film we saw was long.
items.cz: Film, který jsme viděli, byl dlouhý.
accepts: The film we saw was long.
items.explanation: *we saw* says which film, so **the film**. The film we saw was long.
items.explanation_cz: *we saw* říká který film, proto **the film**. The film we saw was long.

items.explanation: A plural in general takes no article: **dogs**. Dogs are friendly.
items.explanation_cz: Množné číslo obecně nemá člen: **dogs**. Dogs are friendly.

items.en: The dogs next door are noisy.
accepts: The dogs next door are noisy.
items.explanation: *next door* says which dogs, so **the dogs**. The dogs next door are noisy.
items.explanation_cz: *next door* říká kteří psi, proto **the dogs**. The dogs next door are noisy.

items.gap: What does she do? She is ____. (engineer)
items.explanation: A job after *be* takes **a / an** — and *engineer* starts with a vowel sound: **an engineer**. She is an engineer.
items.explanation_cz: Povolání po *be* má **a / an** — a *engineer* začíná samohláskou: **an engineer**. She is an engineer.

items.en: He became the manager last year.
items.cz: Loni se stal manažerem tohoto týmu.
items.gap: He became ____ of this team last year. (manager)
accepts: He became the manager of this team last year.
He became the manager last year.
items.explanation: One role in one team, so **the manager**. He became the manager last year.
items.explanation_cz: Jedna role v jednom týmu, proto **the manager**. He became the manager last year.

items.en: I go to bed at eleven.
items.gap: I go to ____ bed at eleven.
accepts: I go to bed at eleven.
items.explanation: **go to bed** with no article is the purpose, not the furniture. I go to bed at eleven.
items.explanation_cz: **go to bed** bez členu je účel, ne nábytek. I go to bed at eleven.
items.wrong: I go to the bed at eleven.

items.en: There is a bed in the room.
accepts: There is a bed in the room.
items.explanation: One of several, first mention: **a bed**. There is a bed in the room.
items.explanation_cz: Jedna z několika, první zmínka: **a bed**. There is a bed in the room.
items.wrong: There is bed in the room.

items.explanation: There is only one **sea** we mean here, so **the sea**. I like the sea.
items.explanation_cz: Tady je řeč jen o jednom moři, proto **the sea**. I like the sea.

items.explanation: Oceans take **the**: **the Atlantic Ocean**. The Atlantic Ocean is cold.
items.explanation_cz: Oceány mají **the**: **the Atlantic Ocean**. The Atlantic Ocean is cold.

items.explanation: A job after *as* takes **a / an**: **a nurse**. She works as a nurse.
items.explanation_cz: Povolání po *as* má **a / an**: **a nurse**. She works as a nurse.

items.explanation: Meals take no article: **have dinner**. We had dinner together.
items.explanation_cz: Jídla nemají člen: **have dinner**. We had dinner together.

items.en: The dinner at their place was lovely.
accepts: The dinner at their place was lovely.
items.explanation: *at their place* says which dinner, so **the dinner**. The dinner at their place was lovely.
items.explanation_cz: *at their place* říká která večeře, proto **the dinner**. The dinner at their place was lovely.
items.wrong: Dinner at their place was lovely.

items.cz: Přístup na internet je tady zdarma.
items.explanation: Uncountable and general here, so no article: **internet access**. Internet access is free here.
items.explanation_cz: Tady nepočitatelné a obecné, proto bez členu: **internet access**. Internet access is free here.
items.wrong: The Internet access is free here.

items.explanation: There is only one **internet**, so **the**. The internet is down again.
items.explanation_cz: Internet je jen jeden, proto **the**. The internet is down again.

items.explanation: **Mount** names take no article: **Mount Everest**. Mount Everest is high.
items.explanation_cz: Jména s **Mount** nemají člen: **Mount Everest**. Mount Everest is high.

cards.title: Three choices
points: Czech has no a / an / the

cards.title: You already know
points: **a** / **an** = one of many. **the** = the one you both mean.
No article at all for a whole group or an idea: I like **dogs**.
Czech has no article, so **the** gets added where English wants none.

examples.en: I bought **a** book. **The** book was cheap.
examples.cz: Koupil jsem knihu. Ta kniha byla levná.

rows: I visited her in the hospital.
The school needs a new roof.
The university is near the park.
The cat is on the bed.
I left my bag at the office.
The dogs next door are noisy.
the Czech Republic, the UK, the USA
the Alps, the Tatras, the Himalayas
the Danube, the Vltava, the Thames

cards.title: Unique

rows: the sun · the police · the internet
the manager · the doctor on duty

points: A job as one of many takes a / an: She is a teacher.

cards.title: Which article?
labels: A name on the map or the calendar, or a fixed case?
Use the pattern: the Danube · Prague · August · the piano · the news
In general: any, all, or the activity?
zero: Dogs are friendly · Life is hard · in hospital · breakfast
Do you both know which one, or is there only one?
the: the dog next door · the sun · the best
One thing: a / an. Some things: nothing. a dog · dogs · a teacher
points: Ask what the listener knows: new, known, or in general.
